race.comment: GEETEE FORTY (14) hasn't won for a long time but is going better than his form reads and has a good turn of foot on his day. Gets a nice drop in grade and will be launching late. RETOURNE (15) was much better here last start when closing off strongly to just miss the well backed fav by a head. Drawn sticky again but with even luck he can go one better. UNWIND (10) couldn't match FANTASTIC HOST at the latest when below her best but meets the winner with a 3kg swing this time. Crowther sticks and looks a genuine winning hope. FANTASTIC HOST (6) often leaves himself with too much to do but put it all together last start when scoring stylishly at Murray Bridge. Already boasts a win over this track and trip and can make it two on the bounce if he holds his form.
